macro_profile.derivation: by D6/reflection reduce to 12 copies of 0<=theta<=pi_source/6; there g=2*cos(theta)/sqrt(3), and integral sec(theta) from 0 to pi_source/6 is log(sqrt(3))
macro_profile.positivity: strict because w_macro is nonconstant on a set of positive hat_nu_infty measure; no decimal evaluation of pi_source is used

edge_young_profile.right_conditional_second_moment: reflection of the left expression, equivalently 3/4+sin(pi_source/3-theta)^2
edge_young_profile.positivity: strict because the limiting two-scale edge-weight law is not almost surely constant

micro_macro_gap.positive: strictly positive because it is the integral of the positive conditional Young-measure variance on interior half-sectors
micro_macro_gap.meaning: the taskbook candidate (3/4)*log(3) is accepted for the squared macro block-average profile, but it is not the second moment of individual edge weights

semantic_boundary: log and trigonometric integration are source-compatibility analytics only. No statement here identifies kappa_perp with kappa_E or asserts a new theorem about standard real pi.
